strategies.title: Funding basis
strategies.description:
Holds the spot asset and shorts the perpetual against it, so the position has no view on the price, and collects the funding the shorts are paid while the two disagree. When funding turns against the carry it unwinds, and when it turns far enough the other way it holds the position the other way round.

The edge is mechanical and it compresses as more capital chases it, which is the honest thing to say about it: the record shows the size it was earned at, and a larger vault should expect less.
strategies.author: 0x9965507d1a55bcc2695c58ba16fb37d819b0a4dc

audits.subject: Vault and factory
audits.note: Not yet audited. A vault's page says so from the day it opens.

legs.key: an agent the vault approved, trade-only
cannot: send a dollar anywhere but back to the vault

limits: Gross exposure at most twice the vault's value
No single order above 5% of the vault
5% of the vault kept liquid, so an ordinary withdrawal closes nothing
Only reduces after a 10% fall from the vault's peak
One market, named in the config, and nothing else
dependencies: the venue's own account stream, for its fills and its funding
the venue's own prices, through the executor's shared data layer
